description.html: The first of its kind, the CeramiClad™ Frying Pan combines the even and responsive heat control of our Award Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with a proprietary Non Stick ceramic coating. Simple to use and just as simple to maintain, our American-Made ceramic coating is made without PFAS, PFOA, PTFE, lead, and cadmium, making for a clean staple that'll last longer than lower-cost counterparts. Designed for everyday cooking, our multi-purpose CeramiClad™ Frying Pans are compatible with electric, gas, and induction cooktops. With solid-but-light construction, and wall curvature, they’re workhorses for everything from sautéed vegetables to crisp-skinned seared fish, over-easy fried eggs, stacks of pancakes, and beyond. Unlike cheaper alternatives, they’re safe up to 550 degrees and feature a Stay Cool Handle™—ideal for dishes that start on the stove and get finished in the oven.

Our high-performing Stainless Clad Cookware gets an elegant upgrade in this new, Limited-Edition 10-Piece Set. A true kitchen workhorse, Stainless Clad offers stellar heat control, responsiveness, and a durable, easy-to-clean surface. To make each piece of our award-winning Stainless Clad cookware, we layer professional-grade stainless steel with highly conductive materials like aluminum for quick, even heating and lightning-fast temperature response. This makes for deeper, more flavorful sears, as well as fewer hot spots and burnt-on messes. For this set, we’ve added display-worthy Antique Brass Finish handles for a fresh twist on your favorite cookware, with the same world-class performance and durability.

Whether you’re outfitting your first kitchen or downsizing to a smaller space, the Small Spaces Set has everything you need—and nothing you don’t. With three of our most essential pieces of Stainless Clad Cookware—a Frying Pan, Saucier, and Saucepan—plus their corresponding lids, this Set is designed to do more with less. It’s ideal for apartments, condos, or anyone looking to streamline their kitchen without sacrificing performance. Crafted in Italy and the USA, and trusted in Michelin-starred kitchens, our Award-Winning Stainless Clad Cookware features 5-ply construction for superior heat conduction and durability. Rolled rims make for drip-free pouring, while a polished cooking surface ensures easy cleanup and exceptional results every time. Whether you’re sautéing, simmering, or boiling, this compact Set delivers pro-level results in any size kitchen.

With a high-performing mix of our best sellers, the 10-Piece Set is curated by chefs to bring you a much-needed cookware reset. Crafted in Italy, our Stainless Clad Cookware is constructed from 5 layers of metals for improved heat conduction. This prevents stuck-on messes and ensures the 5-ply construction cleans up in seconds, while rolled rims easily pour without spilling.

The world’s finest Enameled Cast Iron hails from Northeast France, where craftsmen have been pouring professional-grade cast iron since the early 1920s. So that’s exactly where we headed to craft each piece in our Enameled Cast Iron Collection. From weeknight meals to extravagant entertaining, this dual Set will help you craft a nearly infinite range of dishes. The Award-Winning Round Dutch Oven boasts exceptional heat retention and circulation that transforms tough cuts into tender, fall-off-the-bone braises, while the Skillet brings those benefits to a Southern-style frying pan silhouette, allowing you to sear and maneuver with ease. Stock your kitchen in one click with the heirloom-quality Enameled Cast Iron Set.

products.title: CeramiClad® 2.0 Non Stick Frying Pan Set

description.html: The first of its kind, the CeramiClad™ Frying Pan combines the even and responsive heat control of our Award Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with a proprietary Non Stick ceramic coating. Simple to use and just as simple to maintain, our American-Made ceramic coating is made without PFAS, PFOA, PTFE, lead, and cadmium, making for a clean staple that'll last longer than lower-cost counterparts. Designed for everyday cooking, our multi-purpose CeramiClad™ Frying Pans are compatible with electric, gas, and induction cooktops. With solid-but-light construction, and wall curvature, they’re workhorses for everything from sautéed vegetables to crisp-skinned seared fish, over-easy fried eggs, stacks of pancakes, and beyond. Unlike cheaper alternatives, they’re safe up to 550 degrees and feature a Stay Cool Handle™—ideal for dishes that start on the stove and get finished in the oven.
